headline: You’re losing money by increasing size after a loss

size_up_after_loss.why_it_matters: Increasing size after a loss cost you ₹1,05,732, leading to a loss of ₹1,95,375 and a lower win rate of 28% compared with 39% otherwise.
size_up_after_loss.rule: After a loss, your next entry is your usual size.

averaging_down.note: Averaging down is starting to show up, worth watching but not yet a confirmed habit.

closing: Focus on applying one rule next month to improve results
